Methodology

Exactly how the numbers on this site are produced. Crawl date: 2026-10-17.

1. What we look for

The Universal Commerce Protocol specification says platforms discover a business by fetching its business profile from /.well-known/ucp (UCP specification overview). The profile is JSON with a ucp object containing the protocol version, services, optional capabilities and payment handlers. We fetch that one path per store, nothing else (plus /robots.txt).

2. Which stores we check

1042 domains from three public sources, de-duplicated by domain:

  • Wikidata: retail chains (Q507619) with at least 3 Wikipedia language links, and organisations whose industry is e-commerce (Q484847) with at least 4, each with an official website. Category comes from the Wikidata industry label.
  • A public GitHub list of Shopify sneaker and streetwear stores (ihof/shopify).
  • The first 300 unique domains of a public GitHub list of Shopify stores, mostly Indian D2C brands (TeamDukaan/performance).

This is not a random sample of all online stores. Shares are shares of our list, and category sizes reflect the sources.

3. How we fetch

  • User-Agent: AgenticShoppingIndexBot/0.1 (local research prototype; reads only /robots.txt and /.well-known/ucp)
  • We read /robots.txt first and skip the store if it disallows the UCP path for our agent.
  • At most 12 stores at a time, one request at a time per store, a short pause between requests, 10-second timeouts, HTTPS only. If the listed host is unreachable we try the same domain with or without www..

4. How we classify results

  • UCP profile found: 338 stores
  • No UCP profile (HTTP error, usually 404): 380 stores
  • Request refused (401/403/429): 131 stores
  • Unreachable (timeout, TLS or DNS error): 91 stores
  • Answered but not JSON: 71 stores
  • JSON without a ucp object: 0 stores
  • Skipped: robots.txt disallows: 31 stores

A refused request or timeout does not mean the store lacks a UCP profile; it means we could not check. A "platform hint" of Shopify means the profile's endpoints or extensions reference Shopify.

5. AI assistants table

Retailer names on the AI assistants page come only from official company announcements and help-centre pages, linked per row. We do not test those integrations ourselves.

6. Corrections

If a result is wrong, re-run the check: every domain in the store table links to its live /.well-known/ucp URL.
